Name: Custom Starter Package Builder
Author: tbonehunter
Description:
# Custom Starter Package Builder

A standalone GUI application for configuring Custom Starter Package](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6829) by aedenthorn for Stardew Valley. Uses vanilla items, does not by default include items added by other mods. Does not include clothing, flooring or wallpaper items.

## Features

- **Browse Items by Category**: Seeds, Crops, Resources, Fish, Tools, Craftables, Weapons, Boots, Hats, Trinkets, and more
- **Search Functionality**: Quickly find items by name
- **Select Up to 5 Items**: Choose the items you want in your starter package
- **Quantity Selection**: Set quantities for stackable items (respects each item's MaxStack)
- **Auto-Detection**: Automatically finds your Custom Starter Package mod folder (even in nested organization folders)
- **Direct Export**: Automatically creates a [CP] Custom Starter Package Config folder in your mods with your selected items
- **Import Item List**: Import updated or modded item lists from the ItemDataExtractor mod which runs as a SMAPI mod

## Requirements

- [.NET 8.0 Runtime](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0)
- [Custom Starter Package](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6829) mod by aedenthorn
- [SMAPI](https://smapi.io/) mod loader

## How to Use

1. **Run the application** before launching Stardew Valley: (Extract the zip file, run the "CustomStarterPackageBuilder.exe" executable.)
2. **Browse or search** for items you want in your starter package
3. **Click "Add →"** or double-click to add items 
4. **Set quantities** for stackable items using the quantity text boxes (see note below**)
5. **Review your selections** in the right panel
6. **Verify the output path** (auto-detected or browse to your CSP mod folder)
7. **Click "Save Configuration"** to save your settings
8. **Launch Stardew Valley** - your starter items will appear when starting a new game!

## Output Format

The tool creates a CP mod to your mod directory, and configures the starter package there for Custom Starter Package to use on new game launch.

**PLEASE NOTE: the Custom Starter Package mod treats all BigCraftables as single objects even if the vanilla game supports stacking (eg, chests, cheese press.) This GUI will allow you to select multiple items if the vanilla game allows it, but Custom Starter Package will only produce one BigCraftable. You can get around this by manually editing the ~\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Custom Starter Package Config\content.json file to create multiple instances of that item. They will, however, appear as single items in multiple inventory slots rather than stacked items in one slot.
